shots.intent: 首屏用冷蓝科技底与盒装配泡罩同框拿下停留，一秒建立犬猫通用片剂的品类认知

shots.intent: 把四条核心接受度利益压成一行细线圆标，一眼读完不堆字
shots.textZone: 四枚图标下方各一行实色标签位，下部色带内一行主标题位

shots.intent: 用三格日常不适现象让犬猫主人立刻对号入座，放大问题
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带，三卡下方各一枚实色标签带文字位

shots.intent: 用左侧实心编号圆片加短说明条把四条选择理由讲成可扫读的结构，承接痛点

shots.intent: 用同构六圆标把适用范围一次讲清，替代口头保证
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位与一行短句位，六枚圆标下方各一行标签位

shots.intent: 微距呈现铝箔泡罩与片剂实貌，用可见内容物佐证剂型与封装做工

shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位，两卡各一枚编号圆片与下方实色标签带文字位

shots.intent: 用开盒三件套的实物构成降低真伪与缺件顾虑，只靠可见细节背书

shots.intent: 收口回到首屏同一冷蓝科技底，用一个低摩擦按钮完成闭环
shots.textZone: 右半区主标题带与一行短句位，其下一枚圆角按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: two linked systems held to one language: clinical gradient screens running from deep blue #2E7CE6 at the top into ice blue #E8F1FB with a faint regular hexagon molecular mesh in #FFFFFF and one diagonal light beam, used for the opening and closing screens, and flat ice-blue #E8F1FB or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying rounded cards #FFFFFF with 20px corner radius and solid azure label bands #2E7CE6, used for every mid-page screen
style.direction: clinical-trust pet pharmacy tech detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line white glyphs #FFFFFF inside #FFFFFF circles ringed once in #2E7CE6 with one solid azure caption band beneath, plain solid round pictogram tokens, solid round numbered chips in #F5A623 with #FFFFFF digits, and matched crossed-circle tokens in #FFFFFF ringed in #2E7CE6; no seals, no medals, no ribbons, no anatomical organ drawings, no realistic microbe illustrations
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key clinical studio light from the front-top at 6000K with a large bounce fill, low-contrast soft gradients, one gentle rim along the carton edge, matte controlled speculars on the foil blisters, soft contact shadows under every object so nothing floats
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-trust pet pharmacy ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of deep blue panel #2E7CE6, one deeper pharmacy blue #1B5FD9, ice-blue field #E8F1FB and card field #FFFFFF, with one warm orange numbering accent #F5A623, one shallow gold band #E8C070 and one jewel-blue text color #143A6B; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif Chinese typography with one headline weight per screen, a kicker chip above each headline, headlines in #FFFFFF on azure fields and in #143A6B on ice and white fields, solid azure caption bands 14-20pt; background system alternating clinical gradient screens running from #2E7CE6 into #E8F1FB carrying a faint regular hexagon molecular mesh in #FFFFFF and one diagonal light beam, and flat ice-blue #E8F1FB or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying rounded cards #FFFFFF with 20px corner radius and solid azure label bands #2E7CE6; bright even high-key clinical studio light from the front-top at 6000K with a large bounce fill, low-contrast soft gradients, one gentle rim along the carton edge, matte controlled speculars on the foil blisters and soft contact shadows under every object so nothing floats; glossy white acrylic podium #FFFFFF over a matte ice-blue panel #E8F1FB with one hairline azure edge #2E7CE6; single-family thin-line white icons inside #FFFFFF circles ringed once in #2E7CE6, solid round pictogram tokens, solid round numbered chips in #F5A623 with #FFFFFF digits and matched crossed-circle tokens; the low rectangular carton standing closed with one foil blister card leaning against it held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale on every screen with carton colour, panel layout and foil dimples true to the reference, tablet discs shown as plain unprinted off-white ovals never counted into a numeric dose, cats and dogs always cropped or turned so no individual animal identity dominates; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes or membership or store stickers, no sales-count or award seals or ribbons, no approval or serial numbers, no fabricated certifications, no numeric strengths or pack counts, no realistic germ or organ illustrations.
noDrift: no QR codes, membership stickers or store badges
no sales-count, ranking or award seals and no ribbon or medal graphics
no approval numbers, registration codes, serial or lot numbers
no fabricated certifications, lab data, recovery rates or efficacy figures
no numeric strengths, pack counts, ages or shelf-life values in rendered copy
no realistic germ or organ illustrations
style.presentationRules: the low rectangular carton standing closed with its lid flap down and one foil blister card leaning against it are held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by soft contact shadows, the carton block colour, panel layout and blister foil dimples true to the reference and never restyled; tablets read as plain unprinted off-white oval tablet discs and are never counted into a numeric dose; cats and dogs are always cropped or turned so no individual animal identity dominates
style.surfaceSystem: glossy white acrylic podium #FFFFFF over a matte ice-blue panel #E8F1FB, with one hairline azure edge #2E7CE6 marking the podium front
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif Chinese with one headline weight per screen; headlines in #FFFFFF on azure fields and in #143A6B on ice and white fields, kicker chips 14-18pt above each headline, band captions and icon labels 14-20pt, spec-row labels 16pt; every rendered line is carried as a placeholder, never as source copy
